title: Choose PhotoSpot's visual world
question: The roll dealt a hand for PhotoSpot's redesign. Keep the assigned direction, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Photobook Plate
options.thesis: Every spot presented as a numbered plate with a hairline caption; the map is the book's fold-out endpaper.
options.viewport: Light map full-bleed above; below, an index sheet of numbered photo plates (P.01…) with small-caps hairline captions; red registration dots mark the top-ranked.
options.risk: Quiet by design — it lives or dies on the photographs carrying the page.

raised.raise: Crouwel's armature: every element snaps to one strict visible grid; hierarchy by scale contrast alone.
Console's seams: panels divide by 1px hairline rules — zero drop shadows anywhere in the app.
Folio's registration: every spot photo appears at identical crop and scale in lists, so images compare honestly.
Specimen's readouts: distance, rank and score set in tabular figures that update in place.

regions.label: LIGHT map, 6 circular photo pins, 2 red rank dots
P.03 photo plate + red registration dot

options.label: The Contact Sheet
options.thesis: The whole app as one contact sheet: every spot a frame, the best circled in red.
options.viewport: Map as the lit sheet; frames numbered in white along the edge; red grease-pencil circles ring the top-ranked spots.
options.risk: The most familiar choice in photography — film nostalgia is the shortcut every photo app takes.

regions.label: dark map, white-ringed pins, 2 red grease circles
thumb grid, frame numbers, red marks

options.label: The Orienteering Course
options.thesis: Spots as numbered controls; the legend ranks them and purple marks only your active leg.
options.viewport: Terrain-color map with numbered control circles; the sheet below reads as the control-description table.
options.risk: Terrain colors can swallow the photographs if the iso palette runs the page.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: spots become numbered controls and the legend ranks them; loses narrowly on audience identification — photographers don't read isometric notation.

regions.label: The Orienteering Course: map region with signature markers

options.label: The Convention Catalog
options.lineage: newsprint event catalogs with hall maps
options.thesis: Thumbnail grid and map are one space: every frame carries a table code that locates it.
options.viewport: Map above keyed to codes; below, postage-stamp photo thumbnails packed edge to edge, each with its code and a circled top pick.
options.risk: Density turns to noise below a strict thumbnail grid.
options.case: Fuses well: catalog grid and hall map are literally our browse model; loses on identification — newsprint catalog culture isn't the photographer's world.

regions.label: The Convention Catalog: map region with signature markers

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms built cell by cell on a visible construction grid.
options.viewport: The map and index snapped to a visible blue armature.
options.risk: Reads as a design exercise before it reads as a photo map.
options.case: Loses both axes: designers know Crouwel, photographers don't; the grid helps layout but hides the photographs.
options.kept: The visible armature: everything snaps to one strict grid.

regions.label: Grid Specimen: map region with signature markers

options.label: Graphite Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels divided by hairline seams; destructive actions isolated in empty space.
options.viewport: Tiled panels of spot data on graphite.
options.risk: This is the neighborhood of the AI-slop look the brief rejects.
options.case: Loses both: no photographer identifies with a terminal, and panels bury the images that are the product.
options.kept: Seams, not shadows: 1px hairline rules divide panels.

regions.label: Graphite Console: map region with signature markers

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Five fixed-scale plates on one shared baseline, captions ranked beneath.
options.viewport: Spot photos aligned at identical scale like specimen plates.
options.risk: Scientific register can cool off the joy of shooting.
options.case: Loses both: a botanist's folio isn't a photographer's ritual, and fixed plates fight the map's spontaneity.
options.kept: Fixed-scale registration: images compared at identical size.

regions.label: Botanical Folio: map region with signature markers

options.label: Variable Specimen
options.thesis: One slider morphs a whole grid of glyphs with a live mono readout.
options.viewport: Giant display glyphs over a live value readout.
options.risk: Type as the subject displaces the photographs.
options.case: Loses both: type designers identify, photographers don't; a morphing glyph grid is not the job of finding a spot.
options.kept: Live tabular readouts for every measured value.

regions.label: Variable Specimen: map region with signature markers

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What photo-map apps ship today, executed flawlessly.
canonCard.viewport: Light map, rounded floating photo cards, blue actions.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
